content: Nsim a un'kyɔm atà bɔr
Yɛsu kàfàtɛn a ba unsà nsim naa:
« Imwol a du kyà asànaa mfum mwɛy kàyöŋà un'kyɔm atà bɔr ntɔn mwan baal ande.
Nde kàtöm asyääl ande mukàbel baar ntɔn un'kyɔm awà, wɛɛ ba bàkwen anki muyà.
Nde kàfàtɔm asyääl asin ntɔn mukàtɛn a baar bàbel naa: "Le, mɛ an'lɔn isa byanswà: mɛ an'dwa in'dim a ngɔɔmà anà ntsür a may amɛ, indiir byanswà byan'kwo. Làyi kà un'kyɔm atà bɔr!"
Wɛɛ ba bàwɛl ya asànaa an'yääm a ngway, ba bàkyen isal aba: umwɛy u ywaŋ ande, wumwɛy u yà ande.
Bumwɛy bàkör asyääl, waa bamɛɛy an'kyeey, waa badwä.
Mfum kàwem nkyɛl, waa kàtöm aŋità ande mudwa adwää baar aban, waa bàwuul bul aba mbaa.
Apan, nde kàtɛn a asyääl ande naa: "Un'kyɔm atà bɔr kan'kwo, wɛɛ baar bàbel ndöŋ batɛy.
Abun, làkyen kà an'kuun a mbwo, làtwääl kà un'kyɔm atà bɔr baar banswà làkàman bɛ."
Asyääl abà laa bàkyen ba u mbwo, bàköŋà ba baar banswà bàmɛn ba, baar abe anà abwɛŋ. Ndwà a un'kyɔm atà bɔr waa yàyöl a baar bàbel.
Mfum kàbilà ntɔn muler baar bàbel, waa kàmɛn mbuur mwɛy mpa kàbwäär ipfɛy a un'kyɔm.
Nde waa kun'fuul: "Un'sam amɛ, ngye apà ayàbilà aben ukɔɔn ipfɛy a un'kyɔm?" Mbuur awà ndaa kàsi anki.
Apan, mfum waa kàtɛn a asyääl naa: "Lun'bäm in'siŋ kà in'kɔl anà kà an'kɔɔ, lun'piy u làpib a nsà. Kwo iyàkal ilel anà nkwoor a an'din."
Abun, bàfàbel baar mbɔɔn, wɛɛ bàfàwal ikikye mpɛl. »
Mfüür a itɛr akà Sɛzar
Apan, Amfarisi bàkàköŋ ntɔn muleŋ naa ba ndaa bun'lwab aben u ntɛɛn ande ŋakwo.

Ungö apan, ba bun'tööm alɔŋki aba anà baar a Ɛlɔdi ntɔn mutɛn a nde naa: « Un'lɔɔŋ, bi ikyàyöb naa ngye loor afàtà anki: ngye afàlɔŋ mbwo a Nzam unsà ndandaa yanswà ukɔɔn alab an'kyän a mbuur asin, ntɔn ngye afàler anki imbuur a baar.
Abun, ikyään, ngye akasii aben: mbwo yàmwo lɛɛ yatɛy mufur itɛr akà Sɛzar? »
Wɛɛ Yɛsu kàkyer ayöb an'kyän an'be aba, waa kafuur naa: « Baar a mpem yweel, ntɔn nkye lan'lwab bɛ ndaa?
Lan'swɛŋ ngim bàfàfur ayà itɛr. » Ba waa bun'mɛɛy itɛr a ngim mwɛy.
Waa Yɛsu kafuul naa: « Idiim anà ikɔb bi byà nà? »
Ba bun'fuur naa: « Byà Sɛzar. » Apan nde kàtɛn a ba naa: « Abun, làpɛ indiir a Sɛzar akà Sɛzar, indiir a Nzam, akà Nzam. »
Mpal bàwem ba mfuur ayi, ba bàkyer abem, laa bàsun'wɛy ba, waa bàkyen.
Ngwiiyà a akü.
Ilä nsil akin, Asadusi bàsin tsütsü apà Yɛsu. Ba bà baar bàfàtɛn naa ngwiiyà kà ukwà yatɛy. Ba bun'fuul naa:
« Un'lɔɔŋ, Mɔsɛ kàtɛn naa: "Isàkal naa mbuur kan'kwà ukɔɔn baan, un'tɔŋ ande asàbääl un'kweel a un'dim, ntɔn nde uböör un'tɔŋ ande baan."
Akà bi bàkäl anà atɔŋ nsambwaar. Wàtàtwɛb kàkäl wàŋàbääl. Nde kàkü ukɔɔn abɔr, waa kàsàwɛy un'kyay ande akà un'tɔŋ ande.
Ya yàkäl abà akà wàyweel, wàtär, tii akà wànsambwaar.
Ungö a ba banswà, un'kaar awun waa kàkü.
Mpal bàsàwiyà baar kukwà, uboo a ba bànsambwaar, un'kaar awà asàkal un'kyay anà? Ntɔn ba banswà bàkäl adim ande! »
Yɛsu kafuur naa: « Bɛ, bɛ làbaŋàdiimà mbwo, ntɔn bɛ làyöb anki itàkal Ndaa Aŋàsɔn, itàkal ngwal a Nzam.
Ntɔn, mpal bàsàwiyà baar, abaal anà akaar bàfàsàtà anki bɔr, wɛɛ ba bàsàkal asànaa akyeey u du.
Unsà ndaa iler ngwiiyà a baar kà ukwà, nkye bɛ làtäŋ anki ndaa kàtɛn Nzam a bɛ naa:
"Mɛ, mɛ in'wà Nzam a Abàlam, Nzam a Isak anà Nzam a Yakɔb?" Nde kà wà Nzam a akü anki, wɛɛ wà baar a mɔ̈ɔ̈. »
In'sɛŋ a baar bàwem an'lɔɔŋ ande, ma màkyer atwà.
Un'kɔɔn kan'söön mfun
Mpal bàwem Amfarisi naa Yɛsu an'dübà Asadusi mun, laa bàköŋ ba,
umwɛy uboo a ba, un'lɔɔŋ a un'kɔɔn, waa kun'fuul ntɔn mukun'lwab ndaa:
« Un'lɔɔŋ, nswɛɛŋ nà ayà kölàköl uboo a Un'kɔɔn? »
Yɛsu kun'fuur naa: « "Ngye asàkwen Mwol, Nzam angye, u mpem angye wanswà, u mɔ̈ɔ̈ angye wanswà, anà kan'kyän angye manswà."
Ayi nswɛɛŋ a kölàköl anà yàtàtwɛb.
Yàyweel yà mfun sye àyi: "Ngye asàkwen un'tɔŋ angye asànaa ngye ŋakwo."
Un'kɔɔn wanswà anà aŋangɔɔm bàtoo u nswɛɛŋ ayi yàyweel. »
Klistɔ anà David
Amfarisi bàkäl aŋàköŋ, waa Yɛsu kafuul naa:
« An'kyän abɛ myà aben ntɔn Klistɔ? Nde wà mwan anà? » Ba bun'fuur naa: « Wà David. »
Nde kàtɛn a ba naa: « Abun, aben David, u mbwo a Dweelà, kun'beelà nde Mwol mpal kàtɛn nde naa:

content.text: tii mpal in'sàsà mɛ aŋankir angye ungyɛl a in'kɔl angye." »

content: « Isàkal abun naa David afun'bel "Mwol", aben nde kan'kwo mufàkal mwan a David? »
Akà mbuur mwɛy kàsàkwo anki mukun'fuur akà ndaa mwɛy. Sɛmà ilä akin, akà mbuur mwɛy kàfàsi anki mukun'fuul ndaa.
